problem: Frozen ImageNet image features cannot adapt to bone-age morphology; investigate last-residual-block adaptation with a matched frozen control
resource_constraint: No CUDA GPU in cloud; CPU partial-backbone experiment, not PRD full GPU E1
prefix: through features.layer4.1; fixed FP32 spatial features
checkpoint_selection: Minimum validation MAE including the unchanged initialization at epoch zero
primary_evidence: Adapted candidate must improve validation MAE over both the initialization and matched frozen control; report all arms and whether the best checkpoint actually updated the image block
holdout_policy: Only after locking a candidate by validation; any later existing-holdout evaluation explicitly exploratory, never independent final acceptance
expected_outputs: best validation raw predictions and metrics
instrumentation_note: Code snapshot refreshed before either training arm started; added explicit selected-checkpoint parameter-change and resume-code proofs.
